insight: Backed by Nvidia and Jeff Bezos; its valuation reached roughly $20B in 2025, up from $500M at the start of 2024.
name: Perplexity
tagline: AI search engine that answers with inline citations.
description: Hybrid search engine that returns synthesized answers with inline citations rather than a list of links. Ships a consumer product and the Sonar API for adding cited search to your own apps and agents.

modelSupport.notes: Pro users select a model per query; Sonar API exposes the search layer.

edge: Pairs a consumer cited-answer engine with the Sonar API, so the same retrieval layer powers both.
pros: Cited search API for your own apps
Pro lets you pick a model per query
cons: Citations can misattribute or be wrong
Weak on niche topics with thin sources

references.title: AI Search Has a Citation Problem
